sources.title: How to pick the right moisturizer for your skin
How to test skin care products
Sunscreen: How to Help Protect Your Skin from the Sun

selection_principles.supported_statement: A basic routine can consist of cleansing, moisturizing and sun protection.
selection_principles.scope: General routine structure; does not validate a particular brand or formula.

selection_principles.supported_statement: For self-reported dry skin, a cream can be a more suitable starting texture than a lightweight lotion.
selection_principles.scope: Texture guidance, not a conclusion from a photo hydration score.

selection_principles.supported_statement: For oily skin, consider gentle cleansing and products labelled oil-free and non-comedogenic; harsh cleansing can irritate.
selection_principles.scope: Requires explicit product-label evidence. These labels do not guarantee individual tolerance.

selection_principles.supported_statement: Fragrance-free and unscented are different claims; masking fragrance and botanical ingredients still require attention.
selection_principles.scope: No allergy-free guarantee can be derived from a missing fragrance keyword.

selection_principles.supported_statement: The AAD recommends broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher and water resistance. FDA guidance describes US label and reapplication information.
selection_principles.scope: SPF alone is not evidence of broad-spectrum protection or water resistance; retain each label field separately. FDA and AAD thresholds must not be misrepresented as identical.

selection_principles.supported_statement: AAD consumer guidance describes trying a new product on a small area before wider use, following normal contact time.
selection_principles.scope: This is not diagnostic allergy patch testing or proof of long-term safety.

selection_principles.supported_statement: The provider distinguishes raw scores from adjusted presentation scores.
selection_principles.scope: No source here establishes a clinical cutoff or a validated score-to-brand mapping. Do not assign skin type, disease, treatment or ingredient concentration from these scores.

engineering_exclusions_not_clinical_rule.policy: Do not certify ingredient avoidance without a complete exact-variant list and current package check.
Keep OTC drug-actives, exfoliating treatments and retinoids outside the baseline suggestion pool pending a separate review.
Do not modify a prescribed treatment or assert compatibility when the medication is unknown.
Do not substitute a US ingredient list for a Turkish or other market variant.
Machine extraction is not human approval or independent clinical validation.
